method: Current measured working tree plus 1216 remaining undrafted characters at pilot mean card/stroke/manifest bytes, plus support articles beyond the nine already authored at observed mean word/manifest bytes. Exact runtime bytes and UTF-8 manifest entry sizes; scenarios rounded only at the final byte. Unknown future reused-passage changes excluded. Contributor evidence is export-ignored. Final published ZIP must be independently measured and hash-checked.

observedEffort.explanation: Original teaching pair plus separate curation/support-diff pair; original Claude confirmation plus both curation confirmations. Native retry required four route executions in this execution: two terminal passes and two harness-readiness failures; one failed exporter discovery and one successful standalone export. No new content review was repeated here.
observedEffort.limits: 166 is the two-initial-reviews-per-batch floor at cap 15; the already necessary extra pilot pair raises observed-plus-minimum-remaining initial assignments to 168. Confirmations, native work, integration and any further splits/reviews are additional. No defensible elapsed-time, AI-credit or exact lexical-support-count forecast.

limits: The 921-word scenario is exactly the current nine-per-twelve ratio applied to 1228 additions: a capacity sensitivity, not a lexical forecast or target.

Nine total words assumes no further support and is not an editorial plan. One word per character is not an upper bound. Reuse, multiple readings and multi-kanji words can move support requirements either way.

Pilot risks and 47 readings for twelve characters are deliberately unrepresentative of the full 3303-entry workload. Bound subsequent packets below fifteen when dictionary/reused-passage complexity demands it.
Future cards, support families, reused passages and corrections may be larger. No compressed/inflated forecast or guard increase follows; measure every actual integrated/public ZIP.

Native acceptance is bounded API35 offline cached-content evidence with shape-only drawing fallback, not phone or handwriting-model recognition. Phone/general-release acceptance is explicitly outstanding.
Do not start a later batch until the pilot has passed signed current-main integration, validation, owner fast-forward publication, CI and exact immutable-ZIP verification.
compatibleClient: Android f9b59a2 or later; old APKs ignore curation and old 8000-entry clients reject the archive.
